thesis: Ben Horowitz argues that while AI disruption is imminent, the societal changes will be more unpredictable than the technological timeline, and the primary danger lies in US regulations slowing progress enough for China to lead the reshaping of society. The discussion also posits that recursive self-improvement is the real trigger for the singularity, which has already occurred, marking a permanent exit from the industrial age where AI offers the best chance to reduce daily human mortality.
